home.title: PQC Security Inspection Course
home.subtitle: Three lab modules: TLS inspection, KEM interoperability, and CAVP pre-testing.
home.pqcasBody: Run a group × signature-algorithm matrix against a target and read the handshake back message by message.
home.kemBody: Compare TLS stacks, negotiate key_share groups, and recover a server's KEM preference order.
home.cavpBody: Walk the ACVP flow for ML-DSA: registration, question pack, local compute, results, report.

steps.registrationBody: Pick the capability to exercise; this session uses fixed capability parameters and the four steps below follow your choice.
steps.packBody: {count} test cases live in a single testGroups[0].tests array.
steps.computeBody: Copy each field from the prompt above and compute in your browser.
steps.resultsBody: tcId 1 is pre-filled as a worked example; finish the remaining {count} to submit.
steps.reportBody: Each capability is submitted and reviewed on its own, then corrected above.

cavp.fixedNote: Capability parameters are fixed for this session; the controls illustrate how Registration is configured.
cavp.exampleNote: tcId 1 ships with the worked example.
cavp.browserComputeBody: Pick a test case, then paste each field; long strings can be pasted whole.
cavp.computeEmpty: Results appear here, and you still paste them back into Results yourself.
cavp.notSubmittedBody: Finish this capability's answers and you can review this report right away.
cavp.allCorrect: All {total} cases match the reference implementation.
